products.product_description: Wild Smoked Pink Salmon, 4-7 ounce portions in clear plastic package. No UPC. Label is read in parts: "***Smoked PINK SALMON***KEEP REFRIGERATED BELOW 38F***LOKI FISH CO***SEATTLE-WA***".
